package_infrastructure.details: All 7 GenixBit replacement packages compiled and verified (genixbit-os-archive-keyring, genixbit-os-apt-config, genixbit-os-base-files, genixbit-os-desktop, genixbit-os-theme, genixbit-os-wallpapers, genixbit-os-installer-config).

production_signing_readiness.details: Production HSM/KMS production signing key ceremony not executed yet. Ephemeral passphrase-protected GPG signing key used for staging isolation.

clean_install_readiness.details: Clean installation of all 7 replacement packages verified via real Docker-isolated Ubuntu 26.04 client container with signed APT staging repository. apt-get check and dpkg --audit both passed.

upgrade_readiness.details: Migration from Candidate 2 legacy packages to GenixBit replacement packages verified. Offline guestfish disk verification confirmed token and filesystem. Pre-migration snapshot, offline migration markers, rollback restoration, and re-upgrade all executed and recorded.

installer_readiness.details: Installer slideshow branding verified. genixbit-os-installer-config package installed and welcome.html branding confirmed (product_name: GenixBit OS, slideshow_verified: true).

vm_readiness.details: Real ISO built via PACKAGE_SOURCE_MODE=genixbit-staging ./build.sh. Candidate 2 UEFI QEMU boot executed (900s window, QMP screenshot captured, disk structure and token verified offline). BIOS and UEFI separate evidence collected.

hardware_testing_readiness.details: Physical bare-metal hardware matrix validation scheduled for subsequent release candidate phase.

security_readiness.details: Negative security tamper tests, tampered payload rejection, untrusted key rejection, and revoked key signature checks verified.

documentation_readiness.details: Legal attribution (UPSTREAM.md, LICENSE, OSS.md) and release gate status documented.

rollback_readiness.details: Staging repository snapshot creation, verification, and rollback verified. qemu-img snapshot rollback executed and disk state restored.

production_repository_readiness.details: Production repository packages.os.genixbit.com remains NOT DEPLOYED as a static status page.
